name: Cloudstep Ape
description: A great grey ape the size of two men, with long arms that carry it from ledge to ledge in a gliding bound. Its fur smells of wet stone and its yellow eyes are patient as weather.

name: Terrace Revenant
description: The shape of a disciple in cracked jade armor, kneeling — until it is not. Its face has been scoured smooth by four hundred years of wind. The blade it lifts is all light and no steel.

name: Storm-Crow Spirit
description: A crow the size of a horse, feathered in slate and silver. Where its shadow passes, the stone blackens and smokes. When it cries, distant thunder answers.

name: Stormcaller Disciple
description: A lean swordsman in a dark mantle lined with silver thread. Ball-lightning walks the length of his blade with the hush of a well-kept secret. The brand on his brow is the eight-pointed star of the Heavenly Sword Tower — they are not welcome here either.

name: Heart-Devouring Gale Tiger
description: A tiger the color of moving cloud, four eyes open, four more closed along its flanks. It does not roar; it inhales, and the air before its jaws goes still. Patriarch Mingshu's last words were 'don't' — the wind took them before he could finish.
